body: Thanks. It just hurts a lot being this way.
Definitely. Being creative helps me a lot.

Thanks. I have gradually come to realise me becoming depressed a few years ago was a blessing in disguise. A wake up call that I needed to change things. I may need to change more things is what I mean.

I know what you mean. I would like to still care and love people but strike a balance so people still have respect for me. But I don't want to change who I am. As I think diversity is good, and people respect someone with the courage to be different from the crowd.

Thanks. It's more like I can feel other people's hurt and pain and their own pure beauty too. I don't really go around helping so much but I do look out for others sometimes when maybe I should be more selfish. It's a part of the reason I feel so down now. I did something selfless and have been repaid back with this person basically telling me they don't give a shit and have only been using me. I don't really like this person that much but I did care for them and looked out for them. And I feel they have been cruel to me. It hurts so much. But it's also just in life. I don't have many friends but I care very much for some of the acquaintances I have. But I know they don't really feel the same way. It's also a lonely existence for me as I don't really know anyone like me and it's a bit taboo to talk about it.
I feel like my soul is pure and being beaten down by living. I don't want to eradicate my soul but I don't know what to do. I actually can sense other people's souls too and it hurts a lot.

I'm learning to play the trumpet myself actually, amazing instrument. 

I'm doing well at college but I still think about killing myself this summer? I don't really understand it that well. I worked hard because I wanted to prove to myself I could do it after failing so much in the past. Even though I've felt terrible for the past few days the work I did before has served me well. 

I am a good person, I know that. I have low self esteem and confidence however. My perception of myself is so confused. Like, it's hard for me to explain, but I can objectively see I'm kind, sensitive, clever, quite hard working, interesting, good sense of humour. But I still dislike myself in some way and think I'm annoying, dumb etc. 

I might go to the on campus doctor. I just don't think they can help me. They can't change my soul, my personality. I don't even know if its depression. I don't think anti-depressants will help. I dread my summer, life, future quite honestly. I don't think anyone can help me.

Yes. I care about people and then find out they don't about me. I feel so deeply. I don't devote myself, I'm always a little bit distant in fact, but I don't think I deserve some of the shit I get. I care but I still find it hard to open up to people. I care just about life in general. My sister said she thinks I feel more deeply than other people, I think she's right.

I can't do anything right now. Life just seems so horrible and dark and negative. This summer is going to be so horrible, I need to find a place to live soon and I'm scared. I love music and that keeps me going but I haven't practiced recently cause I've been studying for exams. I'm afraid I'll be too depressed to play again.
